gloss: branding; brand-building; turning something into a brand

definitions.gloss: branding; brand-building; the process of establishing or elevating something as a recognized brand
definitions.explanation: The act or process of establishing a distinct identity and reputation for a product, service, region, or concept so that it becomes recognized as a premium or desirable brand. Used in business, marketing, and regional development contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{特産品|とくさんひん}→特産品：13483_tokusanhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ブランド{化|か}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
ブランド{化|か}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}して→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧{売|う}り{上|あ}げ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伸|の}びた→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧。

⟦{農産物|のうさんぶつ}→農産物：14360_nousanbutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ブランド{化|か}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}める→進める：01949_susumeru⟧ことで、⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{活性化|かっせいか}→活性化：07563_kasseika⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}している→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧。
examples.english: By promoting the branding of agricultural products, they aim to revitalize the local economy.

notes:
Combines the loanword ⟦ブランド→ブランド：05221_burando⟧ (brand) with the productive suffix ⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ (-ization, turning into). A hybrid wasei compound typical of modern business Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ブランド{化|か}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}める→進める：01949_susumeru⟧: to promote/advance branding
- ブランド{化|か}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}する→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧: to succeed in branding
- ブランド{化|か}⟦{戦略|せんりゃく}→戦略：04869_senryaku⟧: branding strategy
- ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧ブランド{化|か}: regional branding

USAGE:
Very common in discussions of regional revitalization (⟦{地方|ちほう}{創生|そうせい}→地方創生：20989_chihousousei⟧) — local governments across Japan actively pursue ブランド{化|か} of their agricultural products, crafts, and tourism offerings. Examples include {松阪牛|まつさかぎゅう} (Matsusaka beef) and {夕張|ゆうばり}⟦メロン→メロン：05194_meron⟧ (Yubari melon). Also used in corporate marketing contexts for product branding.

RELATED {〜化|か} COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{商品化|しょうひんか}→商品化：30135_shouhinka⟧: commercialization, product development
- ⟦{差別化|さべつか}→差別化：18681_sabetsuka⟧: differentiation — distinguishing one product from competitors
- {高級化|こうきゅうか}: upscaling, making premium
- ⟦{国際化|こくさいか}→国際化：29799_kokusaika⟧: internationalization
